title: Green Grass and Quiet Water
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
A shepherd boy named David sang
the sweetest song of all:
"The Lord's my shepherd; I'm His lamb,
He cares for me, so small."

[Chorus]
The Lord is your good shepherd, too,
He leads you, and He's near;
And even in the dark of night,
there's nothing you need fear.

[Verse 2]
"He leads me to the soft, green grass,
to water, cool and still;
He helps me rest, He feeds me well,
and always, always will."

[Chorus]

[Verse 3]
Now close your eyes, my little lamb,
the night is soft and deep;
Your Shepherd's right beside your bed,
He watches while you sleep.

[Chorus]
mood: Pasture music. A slow, ambling sway moves under the voice, like sheep following their shepherd down to quiet water at the end of the day. The first two verses keep that easy, walking pace through the green grass. By the last verse the amble slows to a stop, lower and softer, the flock lying down and the shepherd watching close by.
